TCP::bandwidth
Description
Returns the bandwidth estimate for the peer, in bytes per second. If
no estimate is currently available, or if route metrics are disabled
or unavailable, then 0 is returned. The details of bandwidth estimate
calculation are proprietary. The values returned are only estimates,
and can vary even during the connection.
Note: Starting with BIG-IP v9.4.2, client bandwidth calculations are
always unavailable, so this function will always return 0. Beginning
in BIG-IP 12.0.0, the command returns a nonzero bandwidth estimate.
Syntax
TCP
::
bandwidth
TCP::bandwidth
Returns the bandwidth estimate for the peer.
Examples
when
HTTP::REQUEST
{
if

]

]

<
XXX

::
uri
"/boring-xxx.css"
}
}
}
